asked.item: Commented GUIDE from own business account, no DM arrived

verdict.reason: The pages say Blotato skips comments from the connected account itself, and they give the steps to test from a different account.

steps.text: Your own comments do not trigger a DM automation.
Blotato skips comments posted by the same Instagram account connected to the automation, even when the comment contains the correct keyword.
To test, publish the automation, sign in to a different Instagram or Facebook account, and leave a new top-level comment on the target post using one of the automation's keywords.
A reply to an existing comment does not trigger the automation.
Confirm the other account receives the direct message, and if no message arrives, open the automation and review its runs and logs.
